svg.title: Correct aperture projection for the MV-150 beam-splitter cube
svg.desc: The MV-150 solid has a 55 by 55 millimetre fold-plane cross-section and a 77.78 millimetre internal diagonal. Projecting that diagonal at 45 degrees gives 55 millimetres. A collimated 55 by 74 millimetre bundle fits inside the nominal 55 by 78 millimetre opening and surrounds the 39 by 39 millimetre field.
svg.text: MV-150 — project the 77.78 mm diagonal, not the 55 mm cube side
nominal optical geometry; usable clear aperture can be smaller after bevels, coating borders or housing
Fold-plane cross-section of the CAD solid
